# The chart fixtures of the dry run's ChartRenderer gate, with the verdict
# of both implementations. ONE table for both test suites, so they cannot
# drift: internal/render/chartgate_test.go (TestChartRefusal, the Go gate,
# checked against Helm's own action.CheckDependencies and
# action.Dependency.List) and tests/unit/bootstrap_test.bats ("the dry run's
# ChartRenderer gate decides with the real helm on real charts", the bash
# gate against the real helm v3). Each suite builds every fixture named here
# and fails on a name it cannot build.
#
# Columns: <fixture> <verdict: render|refuse> <cause of a refusal: -|deps|file|load>
#   deps  helm does not report a dependency as vendored (the vendor advice)
#   file  a file:// dependency (khelm builds it on each render)
#   load  helm cannot load the chart
plain                render  -
vendored-tgz         render  -
vendored-dir         render  -
range                render  -
v1-vendored          render  -
symlinked            render  -
v2-req               render  -
tgz-and-dir          render  -
two-dirs             render  -
missing              refuse  deps
missing-no-version   refuse  deps
helmignored          refuse  deps
misnamed             refuse  deps
wrong-version        refuse  deps
two-archives         refuse  deps
v1                   refuse  deps
v2-req-missing       refuse  deps
dir-and-foo-bar      refuse  deps
dep-no-version       refuse  deps
filedep              refuse  file
filedep-vendored     refuse  file
corrupt              refuse  load
parent-no-version    refuse  load
sub-no-version       refuse  load
